title: OCP-IP 3.0 slave: a 256-word memory behind MCmd / SCmdAccept / SResp, WR, RD and posted WRNP with byte enables and thread IDs

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a request was answered ERR (an address outside 0x000 to 0x3FC or misaligned, or an unsupported MCmd), or a posted write went to such an address

notes: mcmd, maddr, mdata, mbyteen, mthreadid, scmdaccept, sdata, sresp and sthreadid are the OCP slave pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the slave's error events.

A command is accepted the clock after it is presented (ACCEPT_DLY 1, the default). WR and RD are answered DVA (or ERR) two clocks after acceptance with the thread ID echoed; SData carries the word as it was when the request was accepted. WRNP is not answered. MCmd values other than WR, RD and WRNP are answered ERR and do nothing.
